outcome: postnatal follow-up evaluation of brain and other body systems
cohort: A single infant diagnosed prenatally with Dandy-Walker malformation and associated agenesis of the corpus callosum.
finding: The case study demonstrates the neonatal sonographic characteristics and corresponding magnetic resonance imaging appearance of coexisting Dandy-Walker malformation and agenesis of the corpus callosum, highlighting the value of postnatal sonography in evaluation and follow-up.
